concept.title: What is the UNBREAKcable Car FM Transmitter?
concept.shortdesc: This device is a simple plug-in car adapter that broadcasts audio over an used radio frequency on your car's radio and is used in older vehicles to provide modern streaming capabilities for music and hands-free calling. This device offers two seperate audio inputs and has seperate ports for charging.

ul.li: 1. USB Flash Drive Port: USB-A audio port for playing music files on USB thumb drive.
2. MIC: Used for hands-free calling and activating voice assistants on connected mobile device.
3. QC 3.0 Port: Quick-charge (QC) USB-A port deisgned for rapid charging.
4. PD USB-C Port: Power Delivery (PD) type-c port also for rapid charging.
5. LED Display: Screen that displays radio frequency and car battery voltage.
6. Mode Switch: allows user to toggle between Bluetooth Mode and USB Flash Drive Mode.
7. (CH) Channel Button: used to manually switch frequencies on the FM transmitter.
8. Multi-Function Button: A joystick that acts as a central-hub for multiple functions.
9. Bass Booster: Provides bass music quality by ampliflying low-frequnecy audio when activated.
